summary: Solana Co filed an 8-K reporting Items 5.07 (Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders) and 8.01 (Other Events). At its May 21, 2026 annual meeting, stockholders elected directors Joseph Chee, Blane Walter, Edward M. Straw, Cosmo Jiang, Michel Lee, and Sergio Mello, and ratified the appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as auditor for FY2026. The audit committee was reconstituted with Blane Walter (Chair), Edward M. Straw, and Michel Lee. This is a routine current report covering ordinary annual meeting results and a committee change. No special-situation corporate event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change—is present. Therefore, the filing is categorized as 'None'.
